name: Legion's Landing // Adanto, the First Fort

abilities.text: When ~ enters, create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.
When you attack with three or more creatures, transform ~.
{2}{W}, {T}: Create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.

notes: The flip condition is the once-per-combat you-attack event with an intervening-if on attacked-with-ge 3 (the engine sets attackedWithThisTurn before it queues the trigger, game.ts:2404).

issues: When you attack with three or more creatures, transform Legion's Landing. — expected declaring three or more attackers transforms the permanent into Adanto, the First Fort, which then has {T}: Add {W} and {2}{W},{T}: create a Vampire — scripted triggered you-attack + intervening attacked-with-ge 3. The condition is never true on the path the harness uses: Game.simulateCombat (src/engine/game.ts:185-222) queues 'you-attack' at line 221 but never sets players[ap].attackedWithThisTurn — that assignment exists only in the real declare-attackers step (game.ts:2404, immediately before the queue at 2409), and characteristics.ts:462 reads exactly that field. Result: the ability is unreached in the sandbox (verification.sandbox.abilities[1].reached=false) and 2 of the 3 blind scenarios throw 'no legal action matched' because the permanent is still an enchantment producing no mana and offering no back-face activation. The card's second printed line does not function. — CR 603.2 / 508.1

When you attack with three or more creatures, transform Legion's Landing. — expected the count is a condition of the trigger event (checked once, at declare attackers) — scripted modelled as an intervening-if, which the engine also re-checks on resolution. Harmless in practice here (attackedWithThisTurn is not cleared mid-turn), but it is a second, non-printed check; the schema (schema-core.ts:726 `{on:'you-attack'}` strictObject) offers no count on the event, so this shape is the only one available — the defect is the engine gap above, not the choice. — CR 603.4

When Legion's Landing enters, create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink. — expected a token named "Vampire", 1/1 white, lifelink — scripted token op is correct (1/1, W, Vampire, lifelink) and the create-token event fires; the token is only unaddressable because game.ts:1379 names it "Vampire token" when the script omits `name`. Shared harness/convention artifact, not counted against the verdict. — CR 111.4
